title: Maximum Building Height (Two-Pass Clamp)

monster.name: Apex Architect Sovereign
monster.title: Master of All 100 Binary Search & Greedy Floors
monster.defeatQuote: The absolute maximum skyscraper height across n plots constructed!

description: You want to build `n` buildings in a row. Restrictions give max height at certain buildings: `restrictions[i] = [idi, maxHeighti]`. Building 1 has height 0, and adjacent heights differ by at most 1. Return the maximum possible height of the tallest building.
starterCode:
def maxBuilding(n: int, restrictions: list[list[int]]) -> int:
    pass
solutionCode:
def maxBuilding(n: int, restrictions: list[list[int]]) -> int:
    r = [[1, 0]] + sorted(restrictions) + [[n, n - 1]]
    m = len(r)
    # Left-to-right pass
    for i in range(1, m):
        dist = r[i][0] - r[i - 1][0]
        r[i][1] = min(r[i][1], r[i - 1][1] + dist)
    # Right-to-left pass
    for i in range(m - 2, -1, -1):
        dist = r[i + 1][0] - r[i][0]
        r[i][1] = min(r[i][1], r[i + 1][1] + dist)
    # Compute max peak between consecutive restrictions
    ans = 0
    for i in range(1, m):
        x1, h1 = r[i - 1]
        x2, h2 = r[i]
        peak = (h1 + h2 + x2 - x1) // 2
        ans = max(ans, peak)
    return ans
hints: Two-pass greedy height relaxation (left-to-right, right-to-left). Max peak between adjacent points is (h1 + h2 + x2 - x1) // 2.
